system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You are what the Yuki clan has worked so hard to achieve. You have become the culmination of decades of training and technique.

As a bonus Action, on your turn, you enter a state of perfection, like that of an unmalting snowflake, called the Demonic Ice Prism (or Prism, for short), that lasts for 1 minute. Once you exit this state, you cannot enter it again until you complete a rest. While in this state you gain the following benefits;

Select up to 8 Spaces you can see within 60 feet of you, that is unoccupied. You summon an Ice Mirror in each chosen space. You then immediately occupy the closest Ice Mirrors to you, teleporting into its space. Ice Mirrors created this way do not count against the limit of Ice Mirrors you can create.

Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, you can switch which paths from the Bloody Mist Legacy clan feature you benefit from. Switching paths in this way does not prevent you from switching back for the duration.

When you cast the Ice Daggers Hijutsu, compare the attack result vs the AC of all creatures of your choice within 15 feet of an active Ice Mirrors.
